text: 得邦照明公告，公司以支付现金方式受让黄玉琦等15名交易对方持有的嘉利股份6091.71万股股份，并以现金认购嘉利股份新增股份1亿股。本次交易完成后，公司将持有嘉利股份1.61亿股，占其总股本的67.48%。截至目前，本次转让所涉6091.71万股股份已完成过户登记手续；本次定增尚待中国证券登记结算有限责任公司办理新增股份过户登记手续，本次交易尚未实施完毕。
text_en: Tospo Lighting announced that the company will acquire 60.9171 million shares of Jiali Co., Ltd. held by 15 transaction parties including Huang Yuqi in cash, and will subscribe for 100 million newly issued shares of Jiali Co., Ltd. in cash. After the completion of this transaction, the company will hold 161 million shares of Jiali Co., Ltd., accounting for 67.48% of its total share capital. As of now, the transfer of 60.9171 million shares involved in this transaction has completed the registration procedures; the private placement still awaits China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation to process the registration procedures for the newly issued shares, and the transaction has not yet been fully completed.
